summary: Full e2e testing of WC Barbearia (FastAPI+Mongo+React PWA). Backend: 16/16 pytest cases passed (auth, servicos, slot engine with Sunday-closed + Fri/Sat peak gating, booking 200/409/403, loyalty +10 on Concluido with idempotent re-trigger protection, voucher 100pts->R$20, admin guard on PATCH status). Frontend: admin login -> /admin dashboard with 15 appointments + filter chips + status selects visible; register non-member -> /app with loyalty card (0 pts); booking 3-step flow (service -> calendar with disabled Sundays -> 22 slots -> confirm) created appointment successfully with success toast 'Agendamento confirmado!'; /app/fidelidade shows redeem button disabled at 0 pts with 'Pontos insuficientes' label. All data-testids present and working.
critical_code_review_comments: test_loyalty_credit_on_concluido has an unused `return (uid, utok)` that triggers PytestReturnNotNoneWarning (cosmetic, test still passes).
server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') - consider migrating to FastAPI lifespan context manager.
resgatar_fidelidade is not atomic (point debit + voucher insert are two separate ops). Low risk at MVP scale but could be wrapped in a Mongo transaction for correctness under concurrency.
test_credentials: Admin 11999990000/admin123; Member client 11988887777/cliente123; non-members created dynamically via register.
seed_data_creation: Several TEST_ users created dynamically via /api/auth/register during tests (not cleaned up - safe since telefone-based unique and prefix identifies them). Appointments were created on next Tue/Wed/Thu/Fri weekdays.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All features in review request validated end-to-end. backend_test.py covers all critical paths and can be rerun as regression. Peak-day test uses next-Friday which generates fresh data each run; double-booking test uses Tuesday 14:00 so may 409 on reruns within same week - that's expected behavior and the test asserts 409 anyway.
